title: Survival Models for Predictive Maintenance and Remaining Useful Life in Sensor-Enabled Smart Energy Networks: A Review
authors: Mohammad Reza Shadi; Hamid Mirshekali; Maryamsadat Tahavori; Hamid Reza Shaker
reliability_note: Peer-reviewed industrial-energy-focused survival review: horizon event risk, hazard, time-dependent discrimination and Brier/IBS with censoring-aware weighting. Secondary methodological synthesis, not an original industrial model calibration experiment.
